summary: App will use Internet Identity for authentication and a custom user database keyed by principal ID to support role-based access (default role employee on first login) with an owner/admin settings UI to view principals and change roles (e.g., promote to manager).
architectural_notes: Use Internet Identity principal ID as the unique user identifier; store roles/permissions in an app-managed user database.
On first login, create a user record if missing and assign default role = employee; subsequent logins load role from DB.

existing_features.title: Replace the current “Internet Identity + credential login session” gate with an “Internet Identity only” gate: after a successful Internet Identity sign-in, the app must enter the main application without showing the CredentialLoginPage, and the app must determine access from a role stored in the backend keyed by the caller’s principal.

Update the Settings page to manage Internet Identity users by principal: display a table of known users (principal ID in monospace + current role), and provide an admin-only UI control to change a user’s role and save it via the new backend API.

Align navigation visibility and route protection with the principal-based role system: AppShell navigation filtering and RequireRole checks must use the same role source (the backend-stored role for the caller principal) and reliably hide admin-only pages (e.g., Master Data, Settings) from non-admin users.

new_feature_requests.summary: Implement user record auto-creation on first Internet Identity login with default role = employee (user DB keyed by principal ID)
Add role-based access control: load role by principal ID and show pages/permissions accordingly (employee vs manager)
Add owner/admin settings UI to view users' principal IDs and manually change their roles (e.g., employee <-> manager)

Implement backend user-role persistence keyed by principal ID with automatic first-login provisioning: when a principal is seen for the first time, the backend must create a user record with default role = employee (non-admin) and return that role for subsequent calls.

Add backend admin APIs to support owner/admin role management over principals: provide an admin-only method to list users (at minimum: principal ID + current role) and an admin-only method to change a user’s role between employee and manager/admin as supported by the app’s role enum.

If adding new stable state for principal->role storage requires an upgrade-safe migration, create/update the backend migration logic according to the project’s conditional migration policy so existing canister data is preserved across upgrades.

projectName: Internet Identity role-based access with auto-created users (default Employee) and admin role management
